description: The histogram Power BI took away, rebuilt properly. Named bin rules that reproduce numpy exactly, your own bins when you need them, reference lines, curves, and process capability for quality teams. Free, and never blocked Bins you can name: Freedman-Diaconis (default), Sturges, Scott, Rice, square root, Doane, auto, a fixed number or a fixed width, with round bin edges. Bins you choose: type your own edges (0, 10, 12, 15, 20) or set where a bin starts; values outside your edges are counted in the footnote. Reference lines: mean, median and up to four percentiles (P90, P95), for all data or per group, by the quartile definition you pick. Bars as count, percent of group or density; a cumulative % line, a density curve and a fitted normal curve. Groups: overlaid, stacked or one row per group on shared bins (picked automatically until you choose). Dynamic in the Service (no Desktop-only bins), large-data input (Value as column + Count), a smart caption, a methods footnote, four themes, keyboard navigation, high contrast, English and Czech. Readers without a licence always see the free chart: no watermark, no broken report. Premium: capability (per-user licence) Spec limits your way: typed, or from LSL, USL and Target measures so every product or line is judged against its own specification and follows the slicers. Every index: Cp, Cpk, Cpl, Cpu, Cpm, Pp and Ppk (AIAG, Cpm against…
